verses.original: Ὑπομίμνῃσκε αὐτοὺς ὑποτάσσεσθαι ἀρχαῖς ἐξουσίαις πειθαρχεῖν εἶναι ἑτοίμους πρὸς πᾶν ἀγαθὸν ἔργον
verses.transliteration: Hypomimnēske autous hypotassesthai archais exousiais peitharchein einai hetoimous pros pan agathon ergon
verses.literal: Remind [the believers] to submit to rulers [and] authorities to be obedient [and] ready for every good work

verses.original: βλασφημεῖν μηδένα εἶναι ἀμάχους ἐπιεικεῖς ἐνδεικνυμένους πᾶσαν πραΰτητα πρὸς πάντας ἀνθρώπους
verses.transliteration: blasphēmein mēdena einai amachous epieikeis endeiknymenous pasan prautēta pros pantas anthrōpous
verses.literal: to malign no one [and] to be peaceable [and] gentle showing full consideration to everyone . . .

verses.original: γάρ ποτε ἡμεῖς καὶ Ἦμεν ἀνόητοι ἀπειθεῖς πλανώμενοι δουλεύοντες ποικίλαις ἐπιθυμίαις καὶ ἡδοναῖς διάγοντες ἐν κακίᾳ καὶ φθόνῳ στυγητοί μισοῦντες ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: gar pote hēmeis kai Ēmen anoētoi apeitheis planōmenoi douleuontes poikilais epithymiais kai hēdonais diagontes en kakia kai phthonō stygētoi misountes allēlous
verses.literal: For at one time we too were foolish disobedient misled [and] enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures living in malice and envy being hated [and] hating one another

verses.original: δὲ Ὅτε ἡ χρηστότης τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν Σωτῆρος καὶ ἡ φιλανθρωπία ἐπεφάνη
verses.transliteration: de Hote hē chrēstotēs tou Theou hēmōn Sōtēros kai hē philanthrōpia epephanē
verses.literal: But when the kindness of God our Savior and [His] love for mankind appeared

verses.original: ἔσωσεν ἡμᾶς οὐκ ἐξ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ἔργων τῶν ἃ ἡμεῖς ἐποιήσαμεν ἀλλὰ κατὰ αὐτοῦ τὸ ἔλεος διὰ λουτροῦ παλινγενεσίας καὶ ἀνακαινώσεως Ἁγίου Πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: esōsen hēmas ouk ex en dikaiosynē ergōn tōn ha hēmeis epoiēsamen alla kata autou to eleos dia loutrou palingenesias kai anakainōseōs Hagiou Pneumatos
verses.literal: He saved us not by - [the] righteous deeds - - we had done but according to His - mercy through [the] washing of new birth and renewal by [the] Holy Spirit

verses.original: οὗ ἐξέχεεν ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς πλουσίως διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἡμῶν τοῦ Σωτῆρος
verses.transliteration: hou execheen eph’ hēmas plousiōs dia Iēsou Christou hēmōn tou Sōtēros
verses.literal: [ This is the Spirit ] He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our - Savior

verses.original: ἵνα δικαιωθέντες ἐκείνου τῇ χάριτι γενηθῶμεν κληρονόμοι κατ’ ἐλπίδα αἰωνίου ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: hina dikaiōthentes ekeinou tē chariti genēthōmen klēronomoi kat’ elpida aiōniou zōēs
verses.literal: so that having been justified by [His] - grace we would become heirs with [the] hope of eternal life

verses.original: ὁ λόγος Πιστὸς καὶ βούλομαί σε διαβεβαιοῦσθαι περὶ τούτων ἵνα οἱ πεπιστευκότες Θεῷ φροντίζωσιν προΐστασθαι καλῶν ἔργων ταῦτά ἐστιν καλὰ καὶ ὠφέλιμα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: ho logos Pistos kai boulomai se diabebaiousthai peri toutōn hina hoi pepisteukotes Theō phrontizōsin proistasthai kalōn ergōn tauta estin kala kai ōphelima tois anthrōpois
verses.literal: [This] saying [is] trustworthy And I want you to emphasize . . . these things so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds These things are excellent and profitable for the people

verses.original: δὲ περιΐστασο Μωρὰς ζητήσεις καὶ γενεαλογίας καὶ ἔρεις καὶ μάχας νομικὰς γὰρ εἰσὶν ἀνωφελεῖς καὶ μάταιοι
verses.transliteration: de periistaso Mōras zētēseis kai genealogias kai ereis kai machas nomikas gar eisin anōpheleis kai mataioi
verses.literal: But avoid foolish controversies - genealogies - arguments and quarrels about [the] law because [these things] are pointless and worthless

verses.original: παραιτοῦ αἱρετικὸν ἄνθρωπον μετὰ μίαν καὶ δευτέραν νουθεσίαν
verses.transliteration: paraitou hairetikon anthrōpon meta mian kai deuteran nouthesian
verses.literal: Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition

verses.original: εἰδὼς ὅτι ὁ τοιοῦτος ἐξέστραπται καὶ ἁμαρτάνει ὢν αὐτοκατάκριτος
verses.transliteration: eidōs hoti ho toioutos exestraptai kai hamartanei ōn autokatakritos
verses.literal: knowing that - such a man is corrupt and sinful he is self-condemned

verses.original: Ὅταν πέμψω Ἀρτεμᾶν ἢ Τυχικόν πρὸς σὲ σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρός με εἰς Νικόπολιν γὰρ κέκρικα παραχειμάσαι ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: Hotan pempsō Arteman ē Tychikon pros se spoudason elthein pros me eis Nikopolin gar kekrika paracheimasai ekei
verses.literal: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis because I have decided to winter there

verses.original: σπουδαίως πρόπεμψον Ζηνᾶν τὸν νομικὸν καὶ Ἀπολλῶν ἵνα αὐτοῖς λείπῃ μηδὲν
verses.transliteration: spoudaiōs propempson Zēnan ton nomikon kai Apollōn hina autois leipē mēden
verses.literal: Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos so that they will have everything they need . . .

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἡμέτεροι καὶ μανθανέτωσαν προΐστασθαι καλῶν ἔργων εἰς ἀναγκαίας τὰς χρείας ἵνα μὴ ὦσιν ἄκαρποι
verses.transliteration: de hoi hēmeteroi kai manthanetōsan proistasthai kalōn ergōn eis anankaias tas chreias hina mē ōsin akarpoi
verses.literal: And - our [people] must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet [the] pressing - needs [of others] so that vvv they will not be unfruitful

verses.original: πάντες οἱ μετ’ ἐμοῦ Ἀσπάζονταί σε Ἄσπασαι τοὺς φιλοῦντας ἡμᾶς ἐν πίστει Ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: pantes hoi met’ emou Aspazontai se Aspasai tous philountas hēmas en pistei Hē charis meta pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: All who [are] with me send you greetings . . . Greet those who love us in [the] faith - Grace [be] with all of you
